properties.statement:
THE PRIMARY USER DESCRIBES HIS OWN WORKING MODEL, AND ONE SESSION MEASURED IT. Anthony, 2026-08-11, unprompted.

HIS WORDS: "I guess how I've been treating reflow2 is as a 'funnel' for my instructions, ideas, feedback, requirements and brainstorming. it often comes in random order and often touches upon subjects that I had previously thought about and entered into reflow2 development... both my brother and I kind of work like this of organically developing our projects as we go. probably looking at this session is a good microcosm of how I've developed and used reflow2 so far - and it has kept up pretty well."

⭐ THE CLAIM IS TESTABLE AND THE SESSION TESTED IT. NINE times in one working day, an input that arrived as a fresh thought landed on something the graph already held. None became a duplicate:

  "what's next for governance"            -> six requirements already authored from an external report
  render the docs from the graph           -> viewpoints.md's recorded Direction, the unbuilt half of BL-40
  `claude update` as an aspiration         -> req:frictionless-update, ACCEPTED, explicitly modelled on Claude Code
  feedback as a prioritisation signal      -> req:friction-has-a-severity-bar, considered AND DROPPED, by him
  the backward-trace problem               -> req:no-idea-goes-quiet, accepted, capturing his own complaint 7 days earlier
  the MCP breakage                         -> a defect fact recorded 4 days earlier WITH ITS FIX in its evidence field
  the second user's "put the skill in"     -> report-friction, already shipped in the kit
  his own organic working model            -> req:accreted-intent-becomes-a-design, proposed and unaccepted
  "make search-first automatic"            -> search-first already written into FIVE served skills, and
                                              req:a-discipline-is-delivered-at-the-tool-not-in-a-catalogue,
                                              proposed, which is exactly the delivery mechanism he asked for

The ninth happened WHILE RECORDING THE EIGHTH, which is the cleanest possible demonstration of the pattern.

⚠⚠ THE ASYMMETRY IS THE FINDING, NOT THE COUNT. Every one of the nine was found because an agent WENT AND LOOKED. Nothing surfaced any of them. Had the search not been run, each becomes a near-duplicate node wearing different words, and the graph fills with the same idea nine times. So reflow2 is a funnel on PULL and not on PUSH: it will hold everything and volunteer nothing.

THAT IS THE SAME SHAPE AS THREE OTHER FINDINGS THE SAME DAY, which is why it is recorded as one fact rather than as praise: (1) the loop only sees what an agent hand-carries in (dec:idea-the-loop-only-sees-what-an-agent-hand-carries); (2) skills fire when a user TYPES them, confirmed twice — once by self-measurement in req:skill-use-survives-a-long-session and once from the field by the second user; (3) a fully-diagnosed defect with its fix already written sat four days because no ranking reads measured facts (dec:idea-field-evidence-is-a-prioritisation-input). Four instances, one mechanism: the design's memory is complete and entirely on demand.

⭐ WHY THIS IS FILED AGAINST req:accreted-intent-becomes-a-design RATHER THAN AS A NEW IDEA. That requirement — "a body of intent accreted over years, contradicting itself and never built, can still become a design" — IS the working model he just described, and it is `proposed` and unaccepted. The way the primary user and the second user actually work is captured in the design and never confirmed. That is the eighth collision above, and it is about reflow2's own understanding of who uses it.

WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED: nine collisions in one session is evidence that the ORDER of his input does not cost him coherence WHEN AN AGENT SEARCHES. It is not evidence about how often a session that does not search creates duplicates — nobody has measured that, and it is the number that would say what the pull-only property actually costs.
